entities.name: Massacre Girl
entities.description: An anonymous Rakdos spiker gang leader and contract killer from Ravnica who leaves a trail of terror and murder.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: The demon whose guild Massacre Girl serves as a tool.

entities.name: Cult of Rakdos
entities.description: The Ravnican guild to which Massacre Girl belongs.

entities.name: Etrata
entities.description: An assassin whom Massacre Girl respects.

entities.name: Cecilee
entities.description: An elf follower of a Selesnyan vernadi in the Rubblebelt, killed in Massacre Girl's massacre.

entities.name: Ruzi
entities.description: Cecilee's brother, a Wolf Rider who vowed vengeance and stole Azorius records on Massacre Girl.

entities.name: Nikya
entities.description: Leader of the Gruul Zhur-Taa clan who declared war on the Rakdos raiders.

entities.name: Kal
entities.description: A Gruul shaman whose Izzet spell decimated Massacre Girl's forces.

entities.name: Alquist Proft
entities.description: A detective Massacre Girl was hired to kill and wounded.

entities.name: Judith
entities.description: A Rakdos leader who hired Massacre Girl, was found weakening her own guild, and became Massacre Girl's hostage.

entities.name: Aurelia
entities.description: Boros guildmaster who defeated the brainwashed Massacre Girl.

entities.name: Oba
entities.description: One of the dryads of Trostani, revealed as the true mastermind of the crimes.

entities.name: Zegana
entities.description: Victim whose murder began the Karlov Manor events.

entities.name: Rubblebelt
entities.description: Region of Ravnica where the vernadi massacre and the battle with the Gruul took place.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane where Massacre Girl operates.

entities.name: Vitu-Ghazi
entities.description: Location of the meeting where Oba was revealed as the mastermind.

entities.name: Rescue Girl
entities.description: The Echoverse version of Massacre Girl, Selesnya's preeminent hero with acrobatics and healing magic.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The battle during which Massacre Girl became a minor Rakdos celebrity.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion during which Massacre Girl gained imitators.

events.summary: In 10,075 ZC Massacre Girl is hired to destroy a Selesnyan vernadi in the Rubblebelt and kill its followers, including Cecilee.
events.quote: she was hired to destroy a Selesnyan vernadi in the Rubblebelt and kill its followers

events.summary: Ruzi rallies the Zhur-Taa and burns the Azorius South Records Hall after stealing documents on Massacre Girl.
events.quote: Ruzi later broke into the Azorius South Records Hall and escaped with documents relating to Massacre Girl, before setting the building alight.

events.summary: Gruul Zhur-Taa warriors attack Massacre Girl's Rakdos party; Kal's Izzet spell decimates her forces and she retreats from the Rubblebelt.
events.quote: Massacre Girl herself survived the battle and retreated from the Rubblebelt following this incident.

events.summary: Hired by Judith, Massacre Girl attacks detective Alquist Proft but stops on learning he works with Etrata.
events.quote: She was surprised and managed to injure him, but stopped when she realized he was working with Etrata

events.summary: Brainwashed by the true killer, Massacre Girl kills ten guards and attacks Aurelia, regaining consciousness after losing the fight.
events.quote: killing ten guards and only regaining consciousness after she lost a fight with the Boros guildmaster

events.summary: Released at Vitu-Ghazi where Oba is revealed as mastermind, she escapes with Judith, then attacks and takes Judith hostage on learning of her ploy.
events.quote: Massacre Girl attacked Judith with a knife and took her hostage.

relations.quote: an anonymous Rakdos spiker gang leader and assassin from Ravnica

relations.note: Described as a tool of the demon.
relations.quote: As a tool of the demon Rakdos, Massacre Girl leaves a trail of terror and murder wherever she goes.
Cecilee's brother, the Wolf Rider Ruzi
convinced the Gruul Zhur-Taa clan led by Nikya to join his crusade of vengeance

relations.note: Declared war on the Rakdos raiding party.
relations.quote: Nikya of the Old Ways declared war on the Rakdos raiding party.

relations.note: Took Judith hostage after learning of her ploy.
relations.quote: She spent a considerable amount of time teaching Judith the many ways skin can be separated from a body.
